page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.d2c.24xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server powered by dedicated Intel Xeon 8269CY processors running at a baseline speed of 2.5 GHz. The system is configured with 96 dedicated vCPUs and 352.0 GB of RAM, which provides approximately 3.67 GB of memory per core. The virtualized environment is managed via the KVM hypervisor.

A primary feature of this instance is its massive local storage capacity, which consists of 47,674 GB of HDD storage. For network connectivity, the server provides a baseline network bandwidth of 35 Gbps. This instance does not include any GPU hardware, focusing its resource allocation entirely on compute, memory, and high-capacity local storage.

Given its massive HDD capacity and high core count, this server offers qualitative cost efficiency for storage-intensive applications that require high density rather than low-latency SSD performance. It is suited for distributed file systems, big data analytics, large-scale log processing, and data warehousing workloads.
